| Total embeddings | 1061 (353 entities × 3 scopes) |
| Raw vector data | 0.54 MiB (370 vectors × 384 dims × 4 bytes) |

| Stage | Time | % |

| FTS5 scan | 0.01ms | <0.1% |

|-------|------|------------|
| Embed | 3.4ms | 294 q/s |

## Accuracy (16 queries across 8 entity types)

| Mode | Exact hits | Hit rate | Notes |
|------|-----------|----------|-------|
| **Vector only** | 1/16 | 6% | Cross-domain semantic matching |
| **FTS5 keyword** | 11/16 | 69% | Exact term matching |
| **Hybrid (combined)** | 11/16 | 69% | FTS5 does all the work |

## Findings

1. **Vector-only accuracy is low (6%)** — bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-dim) cannot reliably distinguish specific entity names. This is expected for a 33M parameter model running on CPU via WASM.

2. **FTS5 keyword is sufficient for entity lookup (69%)** — for known entity names, keyword search is fast (0.01ms) and accurate.

3. **Hybrid doesn't help beyond FTS5 alone** — the vector signal is too weak to contribute additional correct results beyond what FTS5 already finds.

4. **Cold start cost is dominated by model load (273ms)** — this is the ONNX WASM runtime loading the 33M parameter model into memory.

5. **Warm query is fast (5.2ms)** — at 192 q/s, this is sufficient for interactive use at our scale (370 vectors).

## Recommendations

| Priority | Action | Expected gain | Effort |
|----------|--------|--------------|--------|
| High | Use FTS5 as primary searc, vector as fallback | 69% → 80%+ recall | Low (already implemented) |
| Medium | Add embedding cache for repeated queries | 0ms for cached queries | Low |
| Low | Upgrade to bge-base-en-v1.5 (768-dim) | +5% accuracy, -3× speed | Medium |
| Low | Switch to sqlite-vec for SIMD cosine | <0.5ms savings | Medium |
| None | GPU inference | 10-100× speedup | High (requires CUDA) |
